name: TMA producer and WGMMA consumer mainloop
summary: Separate TMA data movement from WGMMA computation across specialized warps and coordinate reusable shared-memory stages with an asynchronous pipeline.

strategy.intent: Overlap global-to-shared transfers with Tensor Core computation.
strategy.mechanism: Producer warps fill circular shared-memory stages through TMA while consumer warpgroups wait on full stages, issue WGMMA, and release stages for reuse.
strategy.expected_benefit: Hides memory latency and permits sustained asynchronous WGMMA issue.
tradeoffs: Consumes shared memory proportional to stage count.
Requires correct producer-consumer barrier protocol and warp role assignment.

parameters.name: cluster_shape
parameters.description: Thread-block cluster dimensions used by TMA multicast and scheduling.

parameters.name: kernel_schedule
parameters.description: Warp-specialized schedule policy controlling producer and consumer behavior.

constraints.rationale: This collective composes TMA copies with a tiled GMMA operator.
Overlapping a producer with consumers requires reusable buffered stages.
TMA operations are issued by an elected producer thread and observed through the pipeline.

references.evidence: The collective declares TMA copies, the tiled MMA, shared storage, and PipelineTmaAsync.
The copy atom dispatches rank-specific TMA loads and tensor-map prefetch operations.
